chapter: Big band, Chicago players, recordings and gospel
title: Rudimental snare drumming
summary: Both learned traditional rudiments and consider them useful mainly as exercises.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: I saw the Old Man play one time.
And they did a rudimental snare drum solo at a music convention.
At a music convention. The Old Man can still play that style.
You, of course, learned that traditional way of playing.
Yeah, I did, too. Didn't take me too long to figure out that they really weren't worth too much, except as exercises.
Right, exercises just to loosen up, that's about --
